integrity: Same mathematical model proof and reproducibility checks only; no independent review; possible unindexed equivalent character-norm calculation.
scientific_limitations: Real finite symmetric groups of degree at least four; full regular isotypic block only. The character formula, cycle enumeration principles and symmetry-averaging technique are known; novelty is limited to the exact absolute projection constant, sign support and limiting constant of this block. No independent validation.
title: Exact projection constant of the exterior-square Fourier block on symmetric groups
